answer: Escrowed Reputation Carryover. Each new identity must fund a zephyr escrow that only releases after it completes a fixed threshold of verified work, so the agent pays capital plus delay before earning anything. An onyx bond posted per identity is slashed on the first failed audit, making every clone's expected return negative because the clone cannot recover the escrow or bond before detection. The trellis of work records links payouts to audited output, so a sybil farm pays N times the escrow and delay cost while capturing at most one identity's rewards.
